bio: Giovanni Antonio Colosimo was born on 5 July 1679 and baptized two days later, the son of Francesco Colosimo and Giustina Berardello. His wife was Fenice Rizulo, the mother of his daughter Candida, who was born in 1715. He was buried on 1 May 1752. He is probably John's 7th-great-grandfather.
